title: Courier scheduling delivery of a legal notice in person

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Blue Dart. We have a registered legal notice for you from an advocate's office in Pune.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I don't know the contents, sir, it's sealed. It has to be signed for in person. Can I deliver it tomorrow between ten and one?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Thank you. There is nothing to pay; just keep an ID proof ready when you sign.
